featured_reviews.name: M V Bhaktha
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am updating my review as I felt cheated. On the owners recommendations I made the purchase which was on a expensive side (around ₹10K plus). The lens used for my specs were from Essilor or Carl Zeis don’t remember exactly. When the specs arrived I was not happy with the result of my distance and reading vision, the images used to get kind of distorted especially when I used to move my head side ways while reading. The owner was kind enough to redo my lens and it was redone twice with no change in the results. When I queried the owner that she had used branded lens how can it give such bad results ??? She did not give me convincing answer. She didn’t even have proof proof of authenticity that branded lens were used. Since the specs were not meeting my requirements I politely asked for a refund to which she politely refused. Well that was the end of it, decided not to visit the shop again.
I feel I have been taken on a ride. The workmanship was poor and the quality of lens used was poor - I could figure out that only these two reasons I could think of.
I got my specs made in my hometown with less than half the money she charged me and they are really good and I am very happy.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you Mr. Bhaktha for such valuable feedback 🙏🏻🙏🏻

After a thorough search for the correct optician, I zeroed in on this store at Vasai west and here's my candid review :

1. The owner Mr. Akshay is well informed, well versed in his subject, forthcoming and a courteous guy.
I re-took my eye test with him to cross-check the eye power prescribed by the doctor as I had some major doubts and it turned out that the doctor had indeed over-prescribed. Perhaps it was the optometrist hired by the doctor who was incompetent but finally Akshay took the correct reading.

2.The store has a warm ambience and a pleasant vibe with an aesthetic layout.

3.Prices are very reasonable (And this I say after double-checking other stores in the vicinity) plus there's a pretty good collection of trendy frames for Specs as well as Shades.

4.A special mention for the guy who manages the Store, Mr. Ahad - Personable, well-mannered and polite.

5.I wish them the very best for all their future endeavors and would definitely recommend them to my networks of friends and family.
